items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive Sunday vs DET as details finalized. Houston among teams in mix.
items.why: Trade talks advanced; team comfortable making inactive pre-deal.
items.implication: No fantasy production Week 5; long-term destination TBD (possible HOU reunion with Stroud).
items.opportunity: Target share opens for remaining ARI WRs

items.text: Saquon Barkley OUT (with Tank Bigsby, DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown).
items.implication: Eagles backfield and WR corps thinned; handcuffs/elevations in play.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for remaining PHI RBs/WRs/TE

items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and overall offense downgraded.
items.opportunity: Possible boost to Ravens RBs/TEs in different scheme; fade Lamar stacks

items.text: Ashton Jeanty questionable (foot/ankle); Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby.
items.why: Added foot to ankle; elevated backup.
items.implication: Game-time risk; Hemby handcuff if OUT.
items.opportunity: If OUT, full backfield to other RBs

items.text: Steelers placed WR Michael Pittman Jr. on IR (foot); misses minimum four games.
items.implication: Extended absence; PIT WR depth chart reshuffle.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to DK Metcalf, Calvin Austin etc.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games; wasn't a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff. Kia Kendrick Bourne szn incoming.
items.why: Recent production data shows limited impact.
items.implication: Wilson already primary; Bourne or others may see more post-trade.

items.text: Ridiculous questionable list this week (Chase/Higgins, Jefferson/Addison, Jeanty, Caleb Williams, McConkey, Flowers, Stevenson, Dowdle, McLaurin, Tate, Kamara etc.); bracing for messy Sunday morning.
items.implication: Monitor morning reports closely; many game-time decisions.

items.text: Breece Hall, Stefon Diggs, Quentin Johnston, Michael Pittman OUT (plus others).
items.implication: Major target/carry voids on NYJ, WAS, LAC, PIT.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs and secondary WRs elevated; Pittman to IR min 4 games.

items.text: IN: Jayden Daniels, Chris Olave, Jeremiyah Love, Dallas Goedert (plus Rachaad White, Noah Fant, Mason Taylor).
items.why: Cleared final report; Love not on report after ankle maintenance.
items.implication: Full or near-full roles expected; reverse prior fade assumptions.
items.opportunity: Love workload upgrade; Daniels return boosts WAS; Olave/Goedert reliable

items.text: Jeremiyah Love 4.8 points clear of Allgeier in DK proj; gut says much better role this week despite ankle maintenance and prior low usage criticism. Not on final report.
items.why: Projection accounts for possible media/fan effect on usage; downside still modeled.
items.implication: RB2 upside vs DET if full allotment; Allgeier remains handcuff.
items.opportunity: Higher carry/snap share expected than Week 4
items.conflict: Prior low usage and ankle comments create variance

items.text: Loves: Nico Collins WR8 @TEN (volume/RZ/matchup), Michael Wilson vs DET WR10, Christian Watson vs CHI WR15, Isaiah Likely @WSH TE5, Chase Brown @MIA RB5 (targets/nickname push).
items.why: Target hogs + soft matchups/defenses carved by position; Brown volume with CIN injuries.
items.implication: Strong start candidates; Wilson boosted further by MHJ inactive.

items.text: Cruelest thing for MHJ drafters: not active to face Lions secondary.
items.why: Missed ideal matchup due to trade inactivity.

items.text: Hate negatives on great player Malik Nabers but fear sideways later: knee real issue, can't shake shoulder, JJ McCarthy under center, coaching boomer-up.
items.why: Stacked injury + QB + coaching risks long-term (not this week specifically).
items.implication: Caution on ROS value despite talent; monitor practice.

items.text: Hates: Jordan Addison @NO WR41 (injury wrinkle/tough matchup), Mark Andrews @ATL TE17, Cam Skattebo @WSH RB20, Tony Pollard vs HOU RB28, Jalen Hurts vs JAX QB15 (rough stretch/banged line).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, efficiency/game environment concerns, injury.
items.implication: Fade in lineups; look elsewhere for TE/RB/QB.
